article.body: A new research paper on AI-driven systems explores the importance of data quality for AI development.  The research, published in arXiv, focuses on the challenges practitioners face in ensuring high-quality data for AI systems.  The paper explores the impact of data quality on AI performance and offers potential solutions.  No timeline for a final rule or decision was announced.
